mapper.select: SELECT PREFERRED_NO AS "preferredNo", PREFERRED_CATEGORY AS "preferredCategory" FROM "PREFERRED"
SELECT SUBSTR(SUPPORT_NO, 1, 2) AS "supportNo", SUPPORT_CATEGORY AS "supportCategory" FROM "SUPPORT" WHERE SUPPORT_NO LIKE '__00'
SELECT WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO AS "workcondAddressTypeNo", WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO AS "workcondAddressTypeInfo" FROM WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE WHERE WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO LIKE '__00'
SELECT SUPPORT_NO AS "supportNo", SUPPORT_CATEGORY AS "supportCategory" FROM "SUPPORT" WHERE SUPPORT_NO LIKE #{supportNo}||'__' AND SUPPORT_NO NOT LIKE '__00'

SELECT WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO AS "workcondAddressTypeNo", WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO AS "workcondAddressTypeInfo" FROM WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE WHERE WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO LIKE #{workcondAddressTypeNo}||'__' AND WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO NOT LIKE '__00'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO "RECRUITMENT" VALUES(SEQ_RECRUITMENT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{recruitmentTitle}, #{recruitmentContent}, TO_DATE(#{recruitmentDeadline}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ${jobtypeNo}, #{numOfRecruitmentName}, ${salaryNo}, ${gradeNo}, ${periodNo}, ${daysNo}, ${timeNo}, ${employerNo}, ${salaryMount}, DEFAULT, NULL, DEFAULT, ${memberNo}, DEFAULT, NULL, #{workcondAddressTypeNo})
SELECT SEQ_RECRUITMENT_NO.CURRVAL FROM DUAL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "RECRUITMENT" WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N'

SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO, RECRUITMENT_TITLE, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_ADDRESS, SALARY_NAME, SALARY_MOUNT, TIME_NAME,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 / 60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60) || '초 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전'
ELSE TO_CHAR(WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS WRITE_DATE,
TO_CHAR(RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE FROM RECRUITMENT r LEFT JOIN EMPLOYER e ON (r.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) LEFT JOIN SALARY s ON(r.SALARY_NO = s.SALARY_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_TIME wt ON(r.TIME_NO = wt.TIME_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY RECRUITMENT_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "RECRUITMENT" r JOIN "EMPLOYER" e ON (r.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND ( RECRUITMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR RECRUITMENT_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR BUSINESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' )

SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO, RECRUITMENT_TITLE, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_ADDRESS, SALARY_NAME, SALARY_MOUNT, TIME_NAME,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 / 60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60) || '초 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전'
ELSE TO_CHAR(WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS WRITE_DATE,
TO_CHAR(RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE FROM RECRUITMENT r JOIN EMPLOYER e ON (r.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) JOIN SALARY s ON(r.SALARY_NO = s.SALARY_NO) JOIN WORKCOND_TIME wt ON(r.TIME_NO = wt.TIME_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND ( RECRUITMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR RECRUITMENT_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR BUSINESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' ) ORDER BY RECRUITMENT_NO DESC

SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO, RECRUITMENT_TITLE, RECRUITMENT_CONTENT, RECRUITMENT_PROFILE, NUM_OF_RECRUITMENT_NAME, r.MEMBER_NO, RECRUIT_COMPLETE_FL, TO_CHAR(RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, TO_CHAR(WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS WRITE_DATE, r.JOBTYPE_NO, j.JOBTYPE_NAME, r.SALARY_NO, s.SALARY_NAME, r.SALARY_MOUNT, r.GRADE_NO, g.GRADE_NAME, r.PERIOD_NO, wp.PERIOD_NAME, r.DAYS_NO, wd.DAYS_NAME, r.TIME_NO, wt.TIME_NAME, r.EMPLOYER_NO, e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME, e.BUSINESS_ADDRESS, e.BUSINESS_NAME, r.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO, wat.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO FROM "RECRUITMENT" r JOIN JOBTYPE j ON (r.JOBTYPE_NO = j.JOBTYPE_NO) JOIN SALARY s ON(r.SALARY_NO = s.SALARY_NO) JOIN GRADE g ON(r.GRADE_NO = g.GRADE_NO) JOIN WORKCOND_PERIOD wp ON(r.PERIOD_NO = wp.PERIOD_NO) JOIN WORKCOND_DAYS wd ON(r.DAYS_NO = wd.DAYS_NO) JOIN WORKCOND_TIME wt ON(r.TIME_NO = wt.TIME_NO) JOIN EMPLOYER e ON(r.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE wat ON(r.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO = wat.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND RECRUITMENT_NO = ${recruitmentNo}
SELECT BUSINESS_WORKTYPE_NO, EMPLOYER_NO, bw.WORKTYPE_NO, WORKTYPE_CATEGORY FROM BUSINESS_WORKTYPE bw JOIN EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE ew ON(bw.WORKTYPE_NO = ew.WORKTYPE_NO) WHERE EMPLOYER_NO = ${employerNo}

SELECT RECRUITMENT_PREFERRED_NO, RECRUITMENT_NO, rp.PREFERRED_NO, p.PREFERRED_CATEGORY FROM RECRUITMENT_PREFERRED rp JOIN PREFERRED p ON(rp.PREFERRED_NO = p.PREFERRED_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_NO = ${recruitmentNo} ORDER BY RECRUITMENT_PREFERRED_NO

SELECT RECRUITMENT_SUPPORT_NO, RECRUITMENT_NO, rs.SUPPORT_NO, s.SUPPORT_CATEGORY FROM RECRUITMENT_SUPPORT rs JOIN SUPPORT s ON(rs.SUPPORT_NO = s.SUPPORT_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_NO = ${recruitmentNo} ORDER BY RECRUITMENT_SUPPORT_NO

SELECT RESUME_NO, RESUME_TITLE, r.SALARY_NO, SALARY_NAME, SALARY_AMOUNT, r.GRADE_NO, GRADE_NAME FROM RESUME r JOIN SALARY s ON (r.SALARY_NO = s.SALARY_NO) JOIN GRADE g ON (r.GRADE_NO = g.GRADE_NO) WHERE RESUME_DEL_FL = 'N' AND RESUME_HIDE_FL = 'N' AND WORKER_NO = ${workerNo}
SELECT RESUME_NO, rw.WORKTYPE_NO, ew.WORKTYPE_CATEGORY FROM RESUME_WORKTYPE rw JOIN EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE ew ON (rw.WORKTYPE_NO = ew.WORKTYPE_NO) WHERE RESUME_NO = ${resumeNo}
SELECT j.JOBTYPE_NAME FROM RESUME_JOB_TYPE rjt JOIN JOBTYPE j ON (rjt.JOBTYPE_NO = j.JOBTYPE_NO) WHERE RESUME_NO = ${resumeNo}
SELECT RESUME_NO, rp.PERIOD_NO, wp.PERIOD_NAME FROM RESUME_PERIOD rp JOIN WORKCOND_PERIOD wp ON(rp.PERIOD_NO = wp.PERIOD_NO) WHERE RESUME_NO = ${resumeNo}

SELECT RESUME_NO, rd.DAYS_NO, wd.DAYS_NAME, rd.TIME_NO, wt.TIME_NAME FROM RESUME_DAYSTIME rd JOIN WORKCOND_DAYS wd ON (rd.DAYS_NO = wd.DAYS_NO) JOIN WORKCOND_TIME wt ON (rd.TIME_NO = wt.TIME_NO) WHERE RESUME_NO = ${resumeNo}

SELECT RESUME_NO, rc.CAREER_NO, COMPANY_NAME, TO_CHAR(START_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS END_DATE FROM RESUME_CAREER rc JOIN CAREER_INFO ci ON (rc.CAREER_NO = ci.CAREER_NO) WHERE RESUME_NO = ${resumeNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE "RECRUITMENT" SET RECRUITMENT_TITLE = #{recruitmentTitle}, RECRUITMENT_CONTENT = #{recruitmentContent}, RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE = TO_DATE(#{recruitmentDeadline}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), JOBTYPE_NO = ${jobtypeNo}, NUM_OF_RECRUITMENT_NAME = #{numOfRecruitmentName}, SALARY_NO = ${salaryNo}, GRADE_NO = ${gradeNo}, PERIOD_NO = ${periodNo}, DAYS_NO = ${daysNo}, TIME_NO = ${timeNo}, SALARY_MOUNT = ${salaryMount}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE RECRUITMENT_NO = ${recruitmentNo} AND RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO FROM ( SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO FROM "RECRUITMENT" WHERE EMPLOYER_NO = ${employerNo} ORDER BY WRITE_DATE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT DISTINCT re.RECRUITMENT_NO , re.MEMBER_NO, re.EMPLOYER_NO, MEMBER_NAME, ENROLL_DATE, MEMBER_TEL, BUSINESS_NICKNAME , BUSINESS_CONTENT, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_ADDRESS FROM "RECRUITMENT" re LEFT JOIN "EMPLOYER" e ON(re.MEMBER_NO = e.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" m ON(re.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "BUSINESS_WORKTYPE" bw ON(re.EMPLOYER_NO = bw.EMPLOYER_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_NO = #{recruitmentNo} AND e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME = #{businessNickname}

SELECT BUSINESS_WORKTYPE_NO, bw.WORKTYPE_NO, WORKTYPE_CATEGORY FROM BUSINESS_WORKTYPE bw JOIN EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE ew ON(bw.WORKTYPE_NO = ew.WORKTYPE_NO) WHERE EMPLOYER_NO = ${empNo}
